M-PB-T-001.mitigation: Apply tamper-evident seals or microswitches to detect unauthorized physical access

M-PB-T-002.mitigation: Apply active tamper protection (conductive mesh, potting, voltage/light sensor) with automated response

M-PB-T-003.mitigation: Ensure no debug or programming port is reachable from boundary exterior without disassembly

M-PB-T-004.mitigation: Disable or physically block all removable media ports accessible at the boundary exterior

M-PB-T-005.mitigation: For portable devices: apply full-disk encryption, tamper-evident seal, and remote wipe capability

M-PB-S-001.mitigation: Implement multi-factor physical access control (badge + PIN, biometric, or guarded entry)

M-PB-S-002.mitigation: Use RFID/NFC badge for physical access control; note: relay attack risk without second factor

M-PB-R-001.mitigation: Install camera monitoring or alarm system at physical boundary entry points; route alerts to SOC

M-PB-R-002.mitigation: Route physical security alerts to Security Operations Centre with defined response procedure

M-PB-D-001.mitigation: Physically anchor or bolt down device/cabinet to prevent removal or relocation
